name: Khepri Scarab Dawn Engine
lore: A mobile dawn-engine guardian from Khepra gateworks, not a robot copy of Egyptian myth but the source-culture machine humans later misunderstood as sacred scarab power.
visualDescription: Deityic scarab-forge body of electrum, Nile-black silt glass legs, sun core under royal linen-light membranes.
mapBehavior: Advances slowly, guards Gates, and forces AoE decisions around hard shell armor.
